title: A mercury complex-based fluorescent sensor for biological thiols
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20125-20133
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02268A, Paper
Open Access

Nguyen Khoa Hien, Trinh Thi Giao Chau, Nguyen Dinh Luyen, Quan V. Vo, Mai Van Bay, Son Tung Ngo, Pham Cam Nam, Duong Tuan Quang
A novel fluorescent sensor, Hg(DST)2, was developed for the selective detection of biological thiols, including glutathione (GSH), cysteine (Cys), and homocysteine (Hcy), in fully aqueous solutions at pH 7.2.
